kai: Ran long onboard for glint-96k-int8 and hit deterministic truncation where tail KV vectors become zeroed after a pack boundary. Repro attached.

nina: Can you paste the minimal command?

kai: ./bin/long_onboard --model glint-96k-int8 --context 98000 --prefill 97200 --quant int8-padded --kv-shrink-mode aggressive --kv-pad off --save /tmp/glint-trace.tgz

kai: Short log: 
```
[prefill=97248]
kv_pack: index=98303 -> packed_end=98304 pad=0
kv_pack: index=98304 -> packed_end=98312 pad=8
kv_write: dst=0x7f8a1200 len=2048
kv_read: token=98310 -> slot=456 fingerprint=0xdeadbe
kv_read: token=98311 -> slot=457 fingerprint=0x000000  <-- zeroed
```

parth: 98304 is a 32k*3 boundary for our shard layout (not power-of-two). Looks like the packer wrote an 8-byte pad but memmove used a 2048 length that spilled into next slot. Did you try --kv-pad on or disable shrink?

kai: with --kv-pad on it passes 5/5. With --kv-shrink-mode conservative it also passes. So two mitigations.

eng-runtime: that suggests packer is computing pad but then writing a fixed chunk size that overwrites following slot header when pad>0. Maybe a signed/unsigned length math bug in packed_array_write().

nina: also saw a correlation with int8-padded codec: int8 encoder will align to 8-byte boundary and write trailing zeros; if packer assumes contiguous slot size exactly equals payload it may skip updating slot header for the following slot.

qa-bot: quick triage results:
- baseline fp16: pass
- int8-padded with kv-pad off + aggressive-shrink: fail reproducible at token ~98311
- int8-padded with kv-pad on: pass

parth: Can you dump hex of raw slot headers for 455..458 and the bytes written for 457? Use --dump-raw-kv 455:458 and paste small snippet.

kai: pasted snippet in ticket INF-5172 and uploaded trace to s3://repro/glint/3444444000/trace.tgz. Slot headers show slot 457 header overwritten with zeros and owner id intact for 456/458.

eng-runtime: I'll add an ASSERT in packed_array_write to ensure writes don't cross slot boundary and add a unit test that forces a non-aligned pad >0 at the boundary. Also freezing aggressive shrink until patch lands.

nina: when you open PR, include microtest under tests/longctx/glint_pack_pad_test.py and add CI job with int8-padded codec + kv-shrink aggressive smoke.

kai: filed INF-5172, opened draft PR #5198 with guard + test, and uploaded minimal repro harness. Will update when CI green. Thanks all. :v:
